findings.quoted_text: All right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and to the Advertising Materials (as defined below) shall be and remain the absolute property of TDA forever (but which may only be used during the Term and, subject to the limitations and conditions set forth in this Agreement, thereafter).

All right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and to the Advertising Materials (as defined below) shall be and remain the absolute property of TDA forever (but which may only be used during the Term and, subject to the limitations and conditions set forth in this Agreement, thereafter).
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product and materials passes immediately to the client without explicitly being conditioned upon full payment.
findings.suggested_change: All right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and the Advertising Materials shall remain the Contractor's property until receipt of full payment by the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few small adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause addressing ownership of the work product and materials, it currently transfers rights immediately without being explicitly conditioned upon full payment. I propose updating this to state that all right, title, and interest shall remain the Contractor's property until receipt of full payment by the Client. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
